messages:
mira: Short thread: finalizing runtime contract for 'route_ledger' + how we validate cross-version behavior. Need quick opinions.

tony: compiled ledger at runtime for perf. interpreter only for debug/canary. otherwise p99 spike.

anya: fine, but require explicit explain annotations per route entry so audits can trace decisions. add `explain_id` & `explain_text`.

mira: agreed. also want a small embedded `fallback_expr` string for emergency rules, but guarded by budget.

ops-bot: note: any runtime exec must have timeout and op-count cap. we enforce `exec_budget_ms` at runtime.

tony: propose ledger fields: version, policy_id, routes[], fallback_expr, max_delta_pct, delta_ttl_ms, exec_budget_ms, explain_id. keep it JSON to ease sim.

anya: add `schema_checksum` and `compat_notes` so compiler/runtimes can detect mismatches. runtime should refuse incompatible major versions.

mira: on runtime deltas: allow probe/capacity adjustments but bounded by `max_delta_pct` per-route and global `nudging_budget_ops`. emit `policy.delta_applied` + `delta_source`.

ops-bot: add `X-Policy-Mode: interpreter` header for tenant-scoped debug, but ACL-gated + rate-limited. when used emit `policy.debug=true`.

sim-bot: we should run `ledger-diff` sim: replay sampled traffic through compiled ledger vs interpreter; compute route assignment parity and tail latency delta. fail CI if distribution delta > threshold.

tony: also require `delta_origin_hash` on any runtime delta so postmortems can map deltas to signals.

anya: security: fallback_expr must have no external IO and limited function set. sanitize at compile time. runtime sandboxed.

mira: rollout plan: shadow compile -> ledger-diff sim -> 5% canary with debug headers off -> sanity checks -> ramp. Provide on-demand tenant toggle to force interpreter.

ops-bot: automated checks to run: route parity, p99 latency, error-rate, `policy.fallback_exec_time_ms`.

mira: ok i'll draft RFC: ledger JSON schema + runtime pseudocode + sim job + telemetry keys + canary playbook. reviewers?

tony: i'll review schema & perf budget numbers.

anya: i'll review explain + security sanitization.
